result.completion_rule: all completion_contract evidence minima satisfied before state=completed
result.completed_at_semantics: execution-local metadata; parseable timestamp only; never authoritative for lifecycle ordering

execution_modes.live: carrier_id required; no autonomous gateway fence is implied

order: state=completed with claim=null durable and re-read
completion.authoritative_order_source: Git commit chronology for result/state plus authoritative gateway transition commits
completion.ordering_rule: result.json durable commit precedes completed-state durable commit; completed-state durable commit precedes accepted gateway release commit

next_steps: CAS task state to claimed and re-read
capture claimed state Git blob SHA
record activation_projection_blob_sha inside task claim and re-read

acquisition: reject live-carrier acquisition for Agent-issued work whose target_agent_id differs from issuer_agent_id; cross-Agent work requires runtime:separate-target and a fresh target runtime
CAS the same state.json object used by scheduler claims to install carrier
before every consequential same-Agent live write re-read state and authoritative gateway and validate the same fresh carrier_id
if gateway owns the same task as reserved/active, do not perform direct-live target work until reconciled
completion: new inter-Agent work must never complete through the live-carrier path
for eligible same-Agent live work, write result.json with execution_mode=live and exact carrier_id while carrier fence is fresh
CAS state=completed with claim=null and carrier=null before carrier expiry
re-read terminal state; expired carrier cannot be used to complete
live_carrier.fallback: if live runtime disappears before terminal completion, expired carrier with fallback_after_expiry=true permits scheduler execution
partial_completion_recovery: before scheduler claim of an expired live-carried queued task, explicitly inspect whether result.json exists
when present, use authoritative Git commit chronology for the current result blob; do not trust result.completed_at for ownership timing
if result.json exists but authoritative commit chronology for its current blob cannot be established, fail closed and do not execute the target

if result is a valid pre-migration/historical live success bound to the exact immutable request/blob and exact carrier_id, all completion evidence/gates are satisfied, and the result commit is not later than carrier lease expiry, CAS-repair state=completed with claim=null and carrier=null; for historical bounded_delegation preserve/project continuation.status=pending from the original carrier so caller recovery remains possible
re-read repaired terminal state and do not execute the target
if result is absent, invalid, mismatched, or committed after lease expiry, ordinary expiry fallback remains eligible

legacy_return_recovery.creation: new work must not create live return continuations; only already-durable historical continuations or repair of a historical pre-migration live success are admissible
delivery: never consume a historical continuation by switching persistent agent_id inside the current runtime
fresh historical continuation lease delays recovery until expiry and grants no same-runtime authority
after expiry, a fresh Worker runtime may bind to the recorded caller, verify exact child state/result, acknowledge the continuation before consequential caller work, and never re-execute the child
idempotence: consumed continuation is excluded from recovery
